query: WITH __claimed AS (SELECT "id" AS "id", "attempt" AS "attempt", "payload" AS "payload" FROM "checked_ledger" WHERE "id" = (SELECT "id" FROM "checked_ledger" WHERE "account" = $1 ORDER BY "id" LIMIT 1) AND ("locked_until" IS NULL OR "locked_until" <= $2) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "checked_ledger" AS __work WHERE __work."account" = $3 AND __work."locked_until" > $4) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), __stamped AS (UPDATE "checked_ledger" AS __row SET "locked_until" = $5, "attempt" = __row."attempt" + 1 FROM __claimed WHERE __row."id" = __claimed."id") SELECT "id", "attempt", "payload" FROM __claimed ORDER BY "id"
